# Citations — Agentic Code Quality
# Generated By: Claude Code (Claude Opus 4.6)

All sources used in this research, numbered sequentially. Tier definitions:

- **Tier 1:** Peer-reviewed papers, government/institutional reports
- **Tier 2:** Manufacturer specs, established reference sites, university publications
- **Tier 3:** Industry blogs, conference talks, well-known practitioners
- **Tier 4:** Forums, personal blogs, GitHub discussions

---

**[1]** Aman Madaan et al. "Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback." *arXiv 2303.17651*, March 2023.
<https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.17651>
**Tier:** 1
Data extracted: ~20% absolute improvement across 7 tasks; generate-feedback-refine loop; no supervised training required.

**[2]** Noah Shinn et al. "Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning." *arXiv 2303.11366*, March 2023.
<https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.11366>
**Tier:** 1
Data extracted: 91% pass@1 on HumanEval vs GPT-4 baseline 80%; verbal reflection into episodic memory; no weight updates.

**[3]** Swarnadeep Saha et al. "Branch-Solve-Merge Improves Large Language Model Evaluation and Generation." *NAACL 2024*, October 2023.
<https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.15123>
**Tier:** 1
Data extracted: 26% improvement in human-LLM agreement; up to 50% reduction in consistency issues. **CORRECTION: Does NOT apply to code generation — focused on LLM evaluation and constrained text generation only.**

**[4]** Nat McAleese et al. "LLM Critics Help Catch LLM Bugs." *arXiv 2407.00215 (OpenAI / CriticGPT)*, June 2024.
<https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.00215>
**Tier:** 1
Data extracted: 63% preference for model-written critiques over human critiques on naturally occurring errors; critics found "hundreds of errors" in data rated "flawless"; limitation: critics can hallucinate false bugs.

**[5]** Chunqiu Steven Xia et al. "Agentless: Demystifying LLM-based Software Engineering Agents." *arXiv 2407.01489*, July 2024.
<https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.01489>
**Tier:** 1
Data extracted: 32.00% on SWE-bench Lite (96 fixes); $0.70/instance; three-phase localization-repair-validation; outperformed all open-source agents at publication.

**Tier:** 1
Data extracted: 56% valid bug reports; 32% reportable; 86% validity in top-21 ranked; 100 Python packages tested; 5 bugs reported, 3 patches merged (NumPy, cloud SDKs).
